title: Electrical Cabinet Temperature — Elevated
description: Cabinet temperature P071 = {val} °C. Above minor threshold (40 °C) but below major (55 °C).
probable_cause: Cabinet fan partial failure, clogged filter, or high ambient temperature.
required_action: Log fault. Monitor parameters. Schedule inspection at next planned maintenance.
escalation_path: If ELC-MN-001 is not addressed (log fault. monitor parameters. schedule inspection at next planned maintenance.), the fault will escalate in this order: THM-MD-001, then ELC-MJ-001. Each subsequent code represents a more severe fault state requiring more urgent intervention. Query each related code for its specific thresholds and required actions.
